name: Fire Joker

features.name: Respin of Fire
features.description: When two reels are stacked with the same symbol and no win occurs, the third reel respins.

features.name: Wheel of Multipliers
features.description: A full screen of one symbol triggers a multiplier wheel up to 10x.

review:
A compact 3x3 classic with five lines and two simple features. Not trying to compete with modern swingy games – it's a quick, low-fuss fruit slot that's great on mobile.

The Respin of Fire kicks in when two reels stack the same symbol without a win, giving you a second shot at the last reel. Fill the grid with one symbol and the Wheel of Multipliers spins for 2x to 10x. Medium volatility, a low 800x cap. Perfect for learning the basics.
